content.short: Projection Finance lets users simulate price variations and visualize volatility's impact on a crypto asset portfolio.
content.description: Projection Finance provides a clear, intuitive way to model crypto investment strategies, experiment with risk, and aim to maximize profitability while helping to avoid liquidations. The tool lets you simulate price movements and the effects of buy, sell, and hold decisions across a diversified portfolio, so you can visualize how price changes propagate through the entire set of holdings and impact each individual asset. Designed for hands-on exploration, it enables rapid scenario testing without relying on traditional spreadsheet workflows.
content.meta: Projection Finance enables users to simulate price variations and visualize the impact of volatility. Discover Projection Finance and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
